Font Examples — 1125 Free Google Fonts · Random Sampler

1125 display, script, handwriting, serif, sans and mono families. Random order, every font exactly once, each line in a random text style from: regular, bold, italic, bold-italic, underline, strikethrough, underline+strikethrough, bold+underline, bold-italic+underline+strikethrough, letter-spaced, uppercase.

Fonts are not stored in this repository — install them on your machine, then: CLI: gowkhtmltopdf --font-path <your-fonts-folder> font-examples.html out.pdf · Library: conv.Global().Set("fontpath", "<your-fonts-folder>") (both Converter and ImageConverter). On this dev machine they are installed in a standard user font folder (~/.local/share/fonts), so --use-system-fonts also finds them.

Engine limits: static TrueType TTFs only (variable fonts and CFF/OTTO rejected); bold is matched from real bold faces else synthesized for Latin; italic has no synthesis and falls back to the regular face; overline is unsupported.
